name: interface
source: CREATE PUBLIC INTERFACE Factory(name IDENTIFIER, value BIGINT, element TYPE, text TEXT, flag BOOLEAN, factory MODULE lib.Inner);

name: imports
source: IMPORT rows FROM 'röws.transit'; IMPORT pkg FROM PACKAGE common FILE 'build.transit'; DEPENDENCY common FROM 'https://example.invalid/library.git' REVISION '0123456789012345678901234567890123456789' SUBDIRECTORY 'src';

name: precedence
source: CREATE MODULE m() AS BEGIN USE f(1 + 2 * 3 < 9 AND NOT FALSE OR TRUE, -9223372036854775808, NAME 'it''s', TYPE BOOLEAN); END;

name: table-build
source: CREATE MODULE rows(t IDENTIFIER, v BIGINT, ty TYPE) AS BEGIN CREATE PUBLIC TABLE $t (id $ty PRIMARY KEY, note TEXT); INSERT INTO $t VALUES ($v, '雪 $inert;'); END; CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN USE rows(NAME 'items', 7, TYPE BIGINT); UPDATE items SET note = 'it''s' WHERE id = 7; DELETE FROM items WHERE id = 9; SELECT id, note FROM items WHERE id <= 8 LIMIT 5; END;

name: tests
source: CREATE MODULE rows() AS BEGIN CREATE PUBLIC TABLE items (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY); END; CREATE TEST TARGET tests AS BEGIN TEST 'rows' USING MODULES (rows()) AS BEGIN ASSERT COMMAND (INSERT INTO items VALUES (7)) MATCHED 1 CHANGED 1; ASSERT ROWS (SELECT * FROM items) EQUAL ((7)); ASSERT STATEMENT (INSERT INTO items VALUES (7)) FAILS WITH 'duplicate_key'; END; END;

name: unused-malformed-table
source: CREATE MODULE unused() AS BEGIN CREATE PUBLIC TABLE t (id); END;

name: unselected-malformed-insert
source: CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN IF FALSE THEN INSERT INTO t VALUES (1,); END IF; END;

name: unused-unsupported
source: CREATE MODULE unused() AS BEGIN COMMIT; END;

name: malformed-expected-rows
source: CREATE MODULE unused() AS BEGIN ASSERT ROWS (SELECT * FROM t) EQUAL ((1,)); END;

name: positional-parameter
source: CREATE MODULE unused() AS BEGIN INSERT INTO t VALUES ($1); END;

name: missing-terminator
source: CREATE MODULE m() AS BEGIN END

name: unknown-table-stage
source: CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN SELECT * FROM absent; END;

name: eager-booleans
source: CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN IF FALSE AND missing THEN CREATE PUBLIC TABLE t (id BIGINT); END IF; END;

name: assertion-stage
source: CREATE TARGET default AS BEGIN ASSERT ROWS (SELECT * FROM t) EQUAL (); END;
